meta.disclaimer: Transport links point to official airlines, airports, tourism boards, and licensed operators. Savanna Explorer does not sell tickets, rentals, or SIM cards — book directly with the provider.

Western Cape gateway — Europe and domestic links
Okavango Delta fly-in and safari charter hub
Victoria Falls gateway — links from Johannesburg and Kruger
Zimbabwe side of Victoria Falls — regional flights

domesticRoutes.title: Airlink — regional Southern Africa
domesticRoutes.region: JNB hub to WDH, MUB, LVI, VFA, CPT and more
domesticRoutes.description: Major regional carrier connecting Johannesburg to Namibia, Botswana, Zambia, Zimbabwe, and Mozambique safari gateways.
domesticRoutes.planningTip: Book internal legs early in peak safari season (June–October) — Maun and Livingstone seats fill quickly.

domesticRoutes.title: Proflight Zambia
domesticRoutes.description: Domestic Zambia network — Lusaka to Mfuwe (South Luangwa) and Lower Zambezi bush strips.
domesticRoutes.planningTip: Soft bags under 15 kg required on bush flights to Mfuwe and Lower Zambezi airstrips.

domesticRoutes.title: FlySafair & CemAir (South Africa)
domesticRoutes.description: Low-cost and regional domestic flights within South Africa — useful for Cape Town ↔ Kruger connections via JNB or direct.
domesticRoutes.planningTip: Compare FlySafair, Airlink, and Lift for CPT–JNB–MQP (Kruger) routing vs self-drive time.

domesticRoutes.title: Federal Air — safari charters
domesticRoutes.description: Licensed charter operator for lodge transfers and cross-border bush flights in the greater safari circuit.
domesticRoutes.planningTip: Many Okavango and Linyanti camps include charter transfers from Maun — confirm with your lodge before booking separate flights.

carRental.title: South Africa — getting around
carRental.description: Official tourism guidance on self-drive, toll roads, and licensed transport options nationwide.
carRental.planningTip: SANRAL e-tags speed up Gauteng tolls — cross-border renters need a letter of authorization from the rental company.

carRental.title: Namibia2Go (Gondwana)
carRental.description: Namibia-focused rental fleet with camping-equipped 4×4 options — Windhoek, Swakopmund, and one-way routes.
carRental.planningTip: Book two spare tyres and a compressor for gravel routes — punctures are common on C19 and Damaraland tracks.

carRental.title: Namibia Tourism — self-drive
carRental.description: Official self-drive route planning, road conditions, and rental guidance from the Namibia Tourism Board.
carRental.planningTip: Avoid night driving outside towns — wildlife on tar roads is a serious hazard after dark.

carRental.title: Botswana Tourism — transport
carRental.description: Getting to and around Botswana — Maun and Kasane access, mokoro transfers, and mobile safari logistics.
carRental.planningTip: Most Okavango camps are fly-in only — 4×4 self-drive suits Moremi public camps and Chobe edges.

carRental.title: Zambia Tourism — travel info
carRental.description: Official transport and access guidance for Livingstone, Lusaka, and Luangwa Valley routes.
carRental.planningTip: Livingstone to Mfuwe is often faster by Proflight than two days on the Great North Road.

carRental.title: AA South Africa — cross-border travel
carRental.description: Automobile Association guidance on cross-border vehicle paperwork, carnets, and route preparation from South Africa.
carRental.planningTip: Get your rental cross-border letter before leaving the depot — border posts check financing and authorization.

mobileSim.description: Widest coverage for Kruger, Garden Route, and major cities — prepaid SIM at airport or mall.
mobileSim.planningTip: Register SIM with passport at purchase — required by South African regulations.

mobileSim.description: Best coverage for Namibian self-drive routes — buy at Hosea Kutako airport or Windhoek.
mobileSim.planningTip: Coverage drops on Skeleton Coast and remote Damaraland — download offline maps before leaving towns.

mobileSim.description: Prepaid data for Maun, Kasane, and Gaborone — useful between Delta camps with patchy lodge Wi‑Fi.
mobileSim.planningTip: Botswana SIMs work in most Delta gateway towns; remote camps rely on satellite or lodge Wi‑Fi.

mobileSim.description: Strong coverage in Lusaka, Livingstone, and Mfuwe gateway — prepaid data bundles for safari weeks.
mobileSim.planningTip: Buy a SIM in Livingstone before heading to remote Luangwa bushcamps.

mobileSim.description: Primary prepaid network for Victoria Falls, Hwange, and Harare — USD cash for top-ups common.
mobileSim.planningTip: Victoria Falls town has multiple SIM vendors — carry small USD notes for airtime.

mobileSim.description: Coastal and Maputo coverage — essential for Tofo, Vilanculos, and overland Maputo routes.
mobileSim.planningTip: Register with passport — island lodges may only have intermittent signal.

mobileSim.description: Lake Malawi and Lilongwe coverage — prepaid for Cape Maclear and Liwonde loops.
mobileSim.planningTip: Lake shore villages have better signal than Nyika Plateau highlands.

mobileSim.description: Compare regional eSIM providers if your phone supports it — often easier than nine separate SIMs on multi-country loops.
mobileSim.planningTip: Verify eSIM covers your exact countries — regional Africa packs vary. Local SIMs are usually cheaper for single-country trips.

vehicleCrossBorder.title: Self-drive cross-border checklist
vehicleCrossBorder.intro: Tick off before you reach the border queue. Requirements vary by post and vehicle — see our border guides for post-specific tips.
items: Driver's licence in English or International Driving Permit
Rental cross-border letter / owner authorization if not your vehicle
Third-party insurance valid for destination country (COMESA yellow disc where required)
Temporary vehicle import permit (Zimbabwe, Zambia, Botswana as applicable)
ZA sticker on rear if registered in South Africa
Fire extinguisher and warning triangle (SA cross-border requirement)
Cash in USD or local currency for road tolls and border fees
Unabridged birth certificate for minors (South Africa exit/entry rules)
